payload.core_mechanism_summary: DP with state (i, from, to) to compute min cost to move i disks from rod j to rod k, using optimal substructure with intermediate rod.
payload.rationale: The solution uses a 3D DP array where each layer for i disks stores a 2D table of costs between rods 1-3. This directly matches dp_2d_state: DP over a two-dimensional parameter (source, destination) per subproblem size.
